cohort: Infertile women aged 18 to 45 years diagnosed with a uterine septum and candidates for assisted reproductive technology (ART) who underwent hysteroscopic septoplasty.
finding: Hysteroscopic septum resection appears to improve pregnancy outcomes and live birth rates in infertile women undergoing ART.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was the most common mode of birth (81.8%).
